decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 9.5	The proposed alterations and additions to the house, comprising erection of a single storey side extension with alterations to ground floor windows and doors, alterations to create of a first floor bathroom, raising the internal floor to games and utility rooms, reinstating fireplaces to the breakfast room, creation of a raised patio area to the side of the house, and alterations to internal doors, entrance gate and door to street, as shown on drawings Existing Floor Plan, Existing Plans - Ground Floor, Existing Plans - Fist Floor, Existing Plans - Second Floor, Proposed Alterations - Drawing No. 2, Proposed Roof Plan and Proposed Section; all received 13 October 2009, are satisfactory and would not result in harm to the special architectural or historic interest of the building, nor the appearance and character of the conservation area or living conditions of neighbours. The proposal is considered consistent with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings & Buildings of Local Townscape Character) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Erection of a single storey side extension with alterations to ground floor windows & doors, alterations to create of a first floor bathroom, raise internal floor to games and utlity rooms, reinstate fireplaces to breakfast room, create raised patio area to side of house, alterations to internal door and alteration of entrance gate and door to street.
